description.value:
You fire a paralytic dart at a humanoid you can see within range. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for the duration, and while poisoned this way it is also paralyzed. At the end of each of its turns, it may attempt another Constitution save, ending the power on a success.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional humanoid per slot level beyond 2nd, provided the targets are within 30 feet of one another when chosen.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
